¡{name} quedó pintado de pies a cabeza!: {name} got painted from head to toe!
Artillería de pintura entre chigüires. A: Paint artillery between capybaras. Aim the bazooka, read the wind and knock the rival capys into the river.
Cada partida trae un mapa nuevo. Escribe: Every match brings a new map. Type a number to play one again.
Casi en línea recta y sin viento: duele: Almost a straight line and no wind: it hurts a lot, but you have to hit the capi.
Cinco perdigones en abanico: cráteres pe: Five pellets in a fan: small craters, great for capis standing together.
Cohete con mucho viento: cráter grande y: A rocket the wind pushes around: a big crater and paint for everyone.
Después de disparar tienes 3 segundos pa: After you fire you have 3 seconds to take cover.
El viento empuja la pintura: mira la fle: The wind pushes the paint: check the arrow before you fire.
La Bazuca, La Lejana, La Licuadora y El: La Bazuca, La Lejana, La Licuadora and El Trueno have few shots per team; La Piñita never runs out.
La orilla del llano en tres dimensiones: The Llanos riverbank in three dimensions
La tierra pintada resbala: los capis se: Painted ground is slippery: capys slide downhill.
Mantén para cargar, suelta para disparar: Hold to charge, release to fire
Not a single rival capy is left standing.
Rebota y explota a los 3 segundos: métel: Bounces and bursts after 3 seconds: drop it behind a hill or into a hole.
Se acabaron los turnos y quedaron parejo: Out of turns, and it's a tie.
Se acabaron los turnos: gana el equipo c: Out of turns: the team with more capys standing and less paint wins.
Taladra un túnel largo donde pega: abre: Bores a long tunnel where it strikes: opens a way through and drops the rival.
Tres capis por equipo en la orilla del l: Three capys a side on the Llanos riverbank. Take turns aiming the paint bazooka, read the wind and knock your rivals into the river or paint them all over.
Tus capis terminaron pintados o en el rí: Your capys ended up painted or in the river.
Un capi con 100 % de pintura o que cae a: A capy with 100% paint, or one that falls into the river, is out.
